scripts.setup: for d in extensions/*/; do (cd "$d" && npm ci --ignore-scripts) || exit 1; done
scripts.build: npm run sync && for d in extensions/*/; do (cd "$d" && npm run build) || exit 1; done
scripts.sideload: npm run build && for d in extensions/*/; do (cd "$d" && npm run sideload) || exit 1; done
